# Nova Heritage Group LLC

> Accounting and tax firm in Lee's Summit, Missouri, serving small businesses of every kind and individuals across the Kansas City metro (Missouri and Kansas) and remotely nationwide. Monthly QuickBooks Online bookkeeping, catch-up and cleanup, payroll, sales tax, and business and personal tax preparation with e-filing, on flat monthly plans (an outsourced accounting department). Works with contractors and trades, professional services, retail and e-commerce, real estate investors, new businesses, and individuals. Not a CPA firm; does not perform audits, reviews, compilations, or other attest services.

## Key facts

- Location: Lee's Summit, MO (Kansas City metro). Serves the whole KC metro on both sides of the state line, and clients anywhere in the U.S. remotely.
- Credentials: QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor, Level 2. B.S. Accounting, M.A. Economics.
- Software: QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Payroll; Xero for clients already on it.
- Clients: any small business (contractors and trades, professional services, retail and e-commerce, real estate investors and landlords, new businesses) plus individuals and families who need personal returns.
- Founder: Greg Novakowski, QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor Level 2, B.S. Accounting, B.A. and M.A. Economics, full-charge bookkeeping and data analytics background.
- Terms: fixed fees, month-to-month, 30 days' notice to cancel. Books closed by the 10th of each month.
- Contact: book a 15-minute fit call at https://calendly.com/greg-novaheritagegroupllc · greg@novaheritagegroupllc.com · (913) 213-3503

## Pricing (flat monthly plans; month-to-month)

- Launch: $250/month. Monthly books, simple P&L, QuickBooks setup help. New and solo businesses, no employees, up to 50 transactions a month.
- Essentials (most popular): $500/month. Launch plus payroll, payroll tax filings, W-2s and 1099s, monthly dashboard, closed by the 10th. 1–5 employees, up to 150 transactions a month.
- Full Department: $1,000/month. Essentials plus sales tax filings, the business tax return (1120-S or 1065) and a quarterly planning call. 6–15 employees, up to 400 transactions a month.
- Department + Insights: from $1,500/month. Full Department plus a live dashboard, monthly review call, budget vs. actual and a 12-month forecast.
- Setup fee: $250 (Launch, Essentials) or $500 (Full Department and up).
- Catch-up / cleanup: $375 per month behind ($500 minimum), $190 per month behind with a plan.
- Personal tax return (1040, federal + Missouri): from $250; with Schedule C from $450.
- Business tax return (1120-S, 1065): from $1,800.
- Payroll only: from $175/month. QuickBooks setup and training: $450. S-corp election and payroll setup: $500. Dashboard and AI projects: from $2,000.
